reason: The bottle alone is about $63 shipped, so the only sensible price is the one that locks me into a filter subscription from a brand I've never heard of. I've been burned by 'cancel any time' before, and I'm not starting a new subscription just to get a fair bottle price, then waiting over a week for it.
objection: The deal is built to push me into a recurring plan. $49.99 plus $12.99 shipping for the bottle on its own feels like a penalty for not subscribing, and I don't trust an unknown store to make cancelling easy.
would_change_my_mind: Selling the bottle on its own for around $40 with free shipping and letting me buy filters one-off when I need them, with no subscription required.
